signals.title: Anyaoku Condemns Xenophobic Attacks in South Africa

signals.summary: [Vanguard] Presidential candidate of the National Democratic Congress, NDC, Mr Peter Obi, has pledged to generate, transmit and distribute at least 10,000 megawatts of electricity if elected president in 2027, promising to tackle insecurity, corruption, unemployment and other challenges confronting the country.

signals.title: Tanzanie: un an après la répression électorale, une journée de commémoration sous cloche

Des messes ont été célébrées dès le matin, avant la reprise du travail. signals.title: Sortie du Tchad de la CPI : une aubaine pour les criminels de guerre soudanais ?

signals.title: Tchad : le pays dément les accusations du Niger concernant une frappe de drone
signals.summary: Le Niger estime que son voisin, le Tchad, est responsable de la mort de deux civils sur son territoire, suite à une frappe de drone survenue le 24 octobre dernier. Le Tchad dément lui tout implication. La junte accuse également la France d'être impliquée. Les précisions de Harold Girard, correspondant France 24 à Njdaména.

signals.title: DRC: US sanctions on Rwanda draw mixed reactions in Goma

signals.title: Tanzanie : un an après les violences électorales, le pays reste sous tension

signals.title: Gabon oil rig disaster: Three bodies found, two still missing

signals.title: A year after Tanzania’s bloody election, victims still await justice

signals.title: Ebola: la situation régionale appelle «à davantage de soutien», car «aucun pays n'est actuellement à l'abri»
signals.summary: Les ministres de la Santé des différents pays africains se sont réunis mercredi 28 octobre, lors d'une réunion virtuelle d'urgence convoquée par les autorités sanitaires de l'Union africaine. Le virus Ebola Bundibugyo a été officiellement détecté dans trois régions africaines, avec des cas en RDC, en Ouganda, au Kenya et au Nigeria. signals.title: Tanzanie: un an après les violences électorales, «toujours pas de réponses claires sur ce qui s’est passé»
signals.summary: Le 29 octobre 2025, la présidentielle a basculé dans des violences meurtrières. Un an plus tard, la Tanzanie marque cet anniversaire sous tension. signals.title: Africa Ebola outbreak passes 10,000 cases, mostly in DR Congo
signals.summary: Africa's latest outbreak of Ebola has passed 10,000 confirmed cases, the vast majority of them in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Congolese health authorities said on Tuesday, with almost 5,000 fatalities.

signals.title: Russia's President Putin hosts counterparts from Mozambique, Libya and Equatorial Guinea
signals.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin met for talks with counterparts from Mozambique, Libya and Equatorial Guinea in Moscow on Tuesday following the Gas Exporting Countries Forum.

signals.title: Judge throws out attempted murder case against Zimbabwe VP's ex-wife
signals.summary: After 7 years on remand, the ex-wife of Zimbabwe's vice president walked out of a Harare prison on Tuesday after a judge ordered her release. Marry Mubaiwa had been accused of attempting to murder her former husband Constantino Chiwenga in 2019.

signals.title: Il y a dix ans, la mort de Mouhcine Fikri mettait le feu au Rif

signals.title: Boad Funds 420 Social Housing Units in Ivory Coast
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] The Government of Côte d'Ivoire has officially launched construction work on 420 social and affordable housing units in Yamoussoukro. signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Côte d'Ivoire issued a 20-year Obligation Assimilable du Trésor (OAT) on the West African Monetary Union (UMOA) government securities market. signals.title: Luanda-Lusaka Commercial Flights to Start This Year

signals.title: Malian Army Retakes Strategic City of Kidal After Tuareg Separatists Withdraw

signals.title: The Dfcu Society Scorecard - 6,527 SMEs, 80,000 Women, 62,000 Trees

signals.title: Media Statement - Social Services Committee Concerned About Delays in Implementing Public Protector Recommendations At Gqeberha's Livingstone Hospital

signals.title: Police Intercept Suspected Robbers in Mityana, Recover Two Guns

signals.title: I Have Never Seen a Pregnant Female Minister, MP Says As He Questions Empty Front Bench

signals.title: Au Tchad, le contrôle des mines d’or de Miski provoque de nouveaux affrontements

signals.title: «C’est mon premier investissement en bourse»: à Lagos, ces Nigérians séduits par la levée de fonds de Dangote

signals.title: Who Gets the Clean Energy Jobs and Contracts? How Ghana and South Africa's Plans Can Do More for Women
signals.summary: [The Conversation Africa] Africa's move to cleaner energy could bring women new jobs, businesses and more control over their time. Solar and wind industries could offer paid work, while off-grid electricity and clean cooking could create openings for women to run their own businesses. The goal is to allow for a thorough reassessment of the bill and to restart discussions.
